rationale: Author reread of all six current fields on ten cards. Full individual institutional source responses and original museum HTML/PDF captures are bound to each claim. The independent review found six editorial/evidence issues; each was corrected source-backed: answer leakage, broad role clues, duplicated note, overcertain archaeology, and one-sentence explanations. The old receipt remains preserved separately as historical pre-fix evidence.

A squire is someone who is training to

Squires would even have to clean

proofs.passage: Knights were a social group below the nobility who were expected to go to war and to bring companies of troops with them. As a result, knights needed to be wealthy enough to buy the sophisticated arms, armour and horses needed for a campaign. They were expected to fight on foot. Some men received their knighthoods while on campaign: several French soldiers were made knights before the battle of Agincourt. Fascinating Facts 
A squire is someone who is training to 
become a knight. They need to learn 
how to use a sword and how to ride a 
horse. Being a squire is tough work 
though, and sometimes you have to 
help the knights by doing some jobs  
for them.
What is a squire?
One of the squire’s most important jobs was to look after their knight’s horse. This meant 
you would need to feed it, groom it and sweep up all of it's poo. Ewwwww!

armour for their knight.  
This is how to do it. 
 Put the armour in a waxed  
bag. This stops the bag from 
getting wet. 
 Pour in some sand 
 Wee in the bag 
 Give it a good mix and shake 
the bag around until the armour 
is squeaky clean!  
Squires would even have to clean 
pieces of armour that covered the 
knight’s bottom. This piece of 
armour is called a ‘culet’ How cheeky!
